macros.name: correctionstyle
macros.doc: The style defined by \correctionstyle will be applied to the title as well as the entire environment.

macros.name: enumfont
macros.doc: With the default option setlist=true, the font of all enumeration labels may be changed by redefining \enumfont (\bfseries by default).

macros.name: labelexercise
macros.doc: This command combines \exercisename with the exercise number and can be redefined.

macros.name: labelexercisestyle
macros.doc: This macro, which is initially empty, enables the definition of a specific style for exercise titles.

macros.name: labelsubpartstyle
macros.doc: The commands \labelexercisestyle and \labelsubpartstyle are initially empty, but they allow you to customize the styling.

macros.name: pointsstyle
macros.doc: You can adjust the \points command’s style through \pointsstyle.

envs.name: answers*
envs.doc: The starred version answers* doesn’t display the Correction title.

envs.name: colsenum
